rules.title: Rules
rules.tagline: Take turns. Complete lines. Get the most points.
rules.goalP: Score more points than your opponent.
rules.turnP: Do one of these, then the turn passes:
rules.turnTapEmpty: Tap an empty dot to color it.
rules.turnTapClaim: Tap a dot on a finished, unclaimed line to claim its points (no new dot placed).
rules.scoringP: A line is any straight run of dots — horizontal, vertical, or diagonal. When every dot on a line is colored, it pays its length in points.
rules.scoreCorner: A single corner dot counts as a 1-pt “line”
rules.catchH: The catch — one move, one score
rules.catchP: If your dot finishes several lines at once, you score only the longest. The other finished lines become unclaimed — anyone can grab them on a later turn.
rules.watchP: Against the Beginner, Easy and Medium bots on Triangle, unclaimed lines are drawn as a dashed line. Everywhere else nothing marks them: spot a fully coloured line that hasn’t been crossed off, then tap any of its dots to claim it. Free points for paying attention.
rules.endP: When every dot is colored and every finished line has been claimed. Highest score wins; equal scores draw.
rules.tip1: Avoid moves that finish two lines — you give the rest away.
rules.tip2: Always take a free corner or big completion.
rules.tip3: A 0-point block can be smarter than a small score.
rules.tip4: Late game: scan for unclaimed lines before placing.
rules.modeBots: — five difficulty levels. Beat Easy on one shape to unlock the next.
rules.modeMp: — live with global Elo ranking, chess-style time controls, and rematches.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.tagline: What we collect, why we collect it, and how to delete it.
privacy.whoP: DotDuel is an independent two-player dot-coloring game. The controller of your personal data under GDPR is the developer. Contact:
privacy.collectP: Only what's needed to make the game work and stay fair.
privacy.collectAccount: email, display name, sign-in provider (Google), account creation date. Source: you, via Supabase Auth at sign-up. We also record whether you use the website, the Android app or both, and the last app version you used.
privacy.collectRating: your current Elo, placement-games counter, and last-played timestamp. Source: computed server-side at the end of every ranked match.
privacy.collectHistory: each ranked match stores both players' UIDs, display names, final scores, rating deltas, shape, time control, duration, and how the game ended (normal / timeout / resign).
privacy.collectLive: while a multiplayer game is in progress we store the board, clock, and your turn in our Realtime Database. This is deleted shortly after the game ends.
privacy.collectFriends: your friend list, pending requests, online status, and game invites. If you joined through another player’s invite link or QR code, we record which player invited you (their random invite code — so future referral rewards can be honoured).
privacy.collectDaily: for each daily puzzle you finish — your display name, best score, number of attempts and finish time. Shown publicly in the daily results calendar.
privacy.collectStreak: your day streak (current, longest, last day played). If reminders are on, the app also gets a random reminder key; at reminder time your phone sends only that key to check whether you have already played that day, so you are not reminded for nothing. The reminder time stays on your phone. Deleted with your account.
privacy.collectDevice: your single-player progress, vs-AI/hot-seat stats, theme preference, and tutorial-seen flag. Stored in your browser's localStorage and never transmitted to us.
privacy.collectAnalytics: Google Analytics auto-collected events — page views, device model, locale, screen size, anonymous session ID. Not tied to your account in our system.
privacy.whyContract: account, rating, match history, live game state — all required to operate the multiplayer service you signed up for.
privacy.whyLegit: leaderboard and ranked play — to provide a fair, competitive environment for all players.
privacy.whyConsentAds: Google Analytics AND Google AdSense — both only load after you click Accept on the consent banner. Declined or undecided means neither starts.
privacy.whyConsentNoAds: Google Analytics — only loaded after you click Accept on the consent banner. Declined or undecided means it never starts.
privacy.sharedAds: We use Supabase (database, authentication, realtime infrastructure and serverless functions, hosted in the EU) as our backend provider, plus Google for sign-in and consent-gated Analytics, plus Google AdSense to serve small banner ads on a few menu screens. Both Analytics and AdSense load only after you accept the consent banner. Supabase and Google process data under their standard terms / Data Processing Addenda. We do not sell or share your data with any other third party.
privacy.sharedNoAds: We use Supabase (database, authentication, realtime infrastructure and serverless functions, hosted in the EU) as our backend provider, plus Google for sign-in and consent-gated Analytics. Analytics only loads after you accept the consent banner. Supabase and Google process data under their standard terms / Data Processing Addenda. We do not sell or share your data with any other third party. We do not currently use third-party ad networks.
privacy.keepHistory: up to 24 months after the match ended, then permanently deleted.
privacy.keepLive: deleted within ~24 hours of game end.
privacy.keepAnalytics: per Google's defaults (currently 14 months for event data).
privacy.keepDaily: up to 24 months after the puzzle date, then permanently deleted.
privacy.keepDevice: stays until you clear your browser data.
privacy.rightsP: Under GDPR you have the right to:
privacy.rightAccess: the personal data we hold about you — use “Download my data” in your Profile.
privacy.rightRectify: inaccurate data — use the “Rename” button in your Profile.
privacy.rightErase: your account (“right to be forgotten”) — use “Delete my account” in your Profile. Effect is immediate.
privacy.rightPort: your data — the download above is a machine-readable JSON file you can take elsewhere.
privacy.rightObject: to analytics — use the toggle below or click Decline on the banner at first launch.
privacy.rightComplain: with your national data protection authority if you believe we've mishandled your data.
privacy.rankingsNote: If you delete your account (or are removed for any reason), your display name and account identifier are scrubbed from all public records. However, the rating changes you caused on other players’ Elo are NOT reversed — past matches are immutable. Opponents you played against keep their rating gains and losses; their match history shows “Deleted player” where your name used to be.
privacy.cookiesP: We do not set tracking cookies. Our sign-in (Supabase Auth) uses first-party session storage to keep you signed in. Google Analytics uses cookies, but only if you accept below.
privacy.consentReloadHint: Switching from Accepted to Declined will reload the page to fully stop the Analytics SDK.
privacy.contactP: For any privacy question, data-access request, or complaint:
privacy.effectiveLead: This policy is effective from {0}. We'll update it here if anything material changes. The canonical version is published at

howto.title: How to play
howto.tagline: Watch each move — the board shows exactly what happens.
howto.scenes.place.title: Place a dot
howto.scenes.place.body: On your turn, tap any empty dot to colour it. Then it’s your opponent’s turn.
howto.scenes.corner.title: A corner scores 1
howto.scenes.corner.body: A single corner dot counts as a line of 1 — it scores 1 point on its own.
howto.scenes.lineScored.title: Complete a line
howto.scenes.lineScored.body: Colour every dot on a straight line and it scores its length in points.
howto.scenes.claim.title: Take unclaimed lines
howto.scenes.claim.body: One move can finish several lines — only the longest scores; the others stay unclaimed (glowing). Tap a dot on an unclaimed line to claim its points. Either player can grab them.
howto.scenes.triThreeWays.title: Triangle: 3 directions
howto.scenes.triThreeWays.body: Lines run across and along both diagonals.
howto.scenes.sqFourWays.title: Square: 4 directions
howto.scenes.sqFourWays.body: Lines run across, down, and along both diagonals.
howto.scenes.finish.title: Finishing the game
howto.scenes.finish.body: The game ends once every dot is placed and every line is claimed. Most points wins — equal scores draw.
